output.notes: The source contains the ACL template followed by the BART paper; only BART was used. Headline model: BART large (12+12 layers, d_model 1024). The base config (6+6, 768) is used in the ablations. n_layers is per stack. block_ops describe one decoder layer without its cross-attention, which is listed under mechanisms. Values marked inherited come from the explicit statement that BART uses the Vaswani et al. Transformer: post-LN LayerNorm, residual, FFN biases, tied embeddings and scale. Positional embeddings are taken as learned because the paper says the BART positional embeddings are updated during MT fine-tuning; this departs from Vaswani's sinusoidal encoding. The paper does not say whether GELU is the exact or the tanh form. Heads, d_ff, vocab size and context length are not stated.
